meta.name: Generate and email PDFBolt template PDFs via Gmail webhook

name: Generate and email PDFs from PDFBolt templates via webhook

parameters.content:
## Generate and email PDFs from PDFBolt templates via webhook

Receives template data through a webhook, validates it, generates a PDF from a published PDFBolt template, emails it with Gmail, and returns a JSON success or error response.

### Setup
Install the PDFBolt community node and add your API key from https://app.pdfbolt.com/api-keys. Create or pick a template at https://app.pdfbolt.com/templates, publish it, paste its Template ID into the PDFBolt node, connect Gmail, activate the workflow, and send JSON to the Production webhook URL.

### Input format
Send `templateData` with keys that match your PDFBolt template variables. Add `recipientEmail` so Gmail knows where to send the generated PDF. Optional fields include `filename`, `recipientName`, `emailSubject`, and `emailMessage`.

### Customization
Use this for invoices, quotes, reports, certificates, agreements, or other repeatable documents where the layout stays the same and only the data changes.

## Validate and prepare data
The Code node requires `templateData` and `recipientEmail`, prepares the PDF filename and email text, and routes missing fields to the 400 error response.

## Generate and email the PDF
Paste a published PDFBolt Template ID into the PDFBolt node. PDFBolt merges the template with `templateData` and returns binary field `data`. Gmail sends `data` as the attachment.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: true, status: 'sent', filename: $('Prepare template request').item.json.filename, recipientEmail: $('Prepare template request').item.json.recipientEmail } }}

parameters.content:
## Example webhook payload

The keys inside `templateData` must match variables in your published PDFBolt template.

```json
{
  "recipientEmail": "customer@example.com",
  "filename": "quote-q-1001.pdf",
  "emailSubject": "Your quote is ready",
  "templateData": {
    "quote_number": "Q-1001",
    "client_name": "Example Customer",
    "total_amount": "1250.00"
  }
}
```
